author: Jeronetj3
body:
If you don’t already know, fishing can also be done at home while there’s a fountain (those map items that restore HP/mana) nearby.    
Maybe that eases the pain of it a little.

author: nEmperor
body: My man u/Red_Panda48 would like to have a word

author: RhetoricCamel
body:
Aside from using a fountain to fish from, just start fishing, lock your phone, go home or someplace warm, unlock the phone and continue fishing. 

Also use any fishing line that is better than the normal. The higher quality line, the more fish and items you'll catch.
